lessons.title: Aynı görüşü iki dinleyiciye sözlü olarak uyarla
lessons.objective: Bir öneriyi meslektaşa ve itirazı olan katılımcıya farklı bilgi sırasıyla anlat, ihtiyat düzeyini ve taahhüt sınırını koru.
lessons.situation: Bir topluluk merkezinin kayıt sistemi deneme aşamasında. Analist kapsamı, katılımcı yarınki seçenekleri öğrenmek istiyor.
lessons.bridge: Analiste bulgu ve örneklemle başla. Katılımcıya bugünkü işlemle başla. What we can say is … ile dayanağı, We cannot yet tell whether … ile belirsizliği koru.

models.phrase: What we can say is that waiting times fell for online applicants in the pilot.
models.explanation: What-clause sınırlı bulguyu odaklar. For online applicants kapsamı bırakmaz.

models.phrase: If you prefer to register in person, you can still use the desk.
models.explanation: If kişiye uygun bir yolu açar. Still mevcut seçeneğin devam ettiğini gösterir, yeni bir hizmet sözü vermez.

concepts.label: Odak yapısını doğru tamamla
concepts.incorrect: What can we say is that the queue was shorter.
concepts.correct: What we can say is that the queue was shorter.
concepts.explanation: What-clause içinde düz özne-yardımcı sırası. Bağımsız soru sırası başka bağlamda kullanılır.
guided: Statement: What ___ (we can / can we) say is that fares stayed the same.
What ___ (they need / do they need) is a second entrance.
transfer: What ___ (we found / did we find) was a delay at closing time.
What ___ (the coach wants / does the coach want) is an early trial.
delayed: What ___ (you should / should you) check is whether a space is available.
What ___ (we cannot / cannot we) promise is a Friday delivery.

concepts.label: Kitleye göre ilk bilgi
concepts.incorrect: “All calls are now faster.” The pilot measured only web replies.
concepts.correct: “Online applicants in the pilot received faster replies.”
concepts.explanation: Hitap ve bilgi sırası değişse de kaynak, kapsam ve ölçüm değişmez.
guided: “Only evenings were tested.” Hangi kapsam: evening only / all hours?
“Use the desk if the web form fails.” Katılımcı için eylem: use the desk / expand the pilot.
transfer: “Both groups were small.” Analist için sınırlama: small groups / desk location.
“Thursday’s slots are available, Friday is unconfirmed.” Bugün teyitli seçenek: Thursday slots / Friday slots.
delayed: “The team measured waits, not access.” Ölçülen: waits / access.
“Week-one data excludes repeat calls.” Korunacak sınırlama: repeat calls excluded / all calls counted.

writing.prompt: Pilot verisini iki kısa sözlü metin olarak yaz. Analist için kanıt ve eksik grup, ziyaretçi için yarınki seçenek ve bir teyit sorusu ver. Toplam 125–165 sözcük.
writing.sample: For the analyst: What we can say is that web applicants spent less time waiting during this trial. The test covered two weekday afternoons and did not include callers who gave up before they reached the desk. We should keep the old channel open and collect comparable figures before deciding whether the change works for everyone. For the visitor: If you need to book tomorrow, the desk will still be open from two until four. You can use the web form, too. If you need someone to read the form with you, call before coming and ask whether a volunteer is free. I can show you where the number is. The shorter wait we saw was for some web applicants, so I cannot promise that the desk will be quicker. Which route would be easier for you tomorrow?
writing.revision: İki sürümde kapsam ve kesinlik aynı kalsın. Bir sürümde teknik ayrıntıyı sadeleştir, diğerinde kaynağı belirt. Önceki dersteki check an assumption veya be meant as kalıbıyla ziyaretçinin yorumunu teyit et.
criteria: İki dinleyici için bilgi sırası farklı.
Hizmet koşulları, örneklem ve belirsizlik korundu.

input.text:
Internal note. During the pilot window the median wait for successful web bookings fell from fourteen minutes to eight. The desk queue was counted only after people checked in. No one recorded people who walked away or could not read the sign. A volunteer helped some applicants but was available on only one day. Comparing all applicants would require a count of unfinished bookings and a record of volunteer hours.

Visitor notice. The desk stays open at the usual times tomorrow. If you want help with the form, call first so we can tell you whether a volunteer is in. The web form remains available from home. A faster wait is not guaranteed at the desk. We are still testing these arrangements and will post next week’s hours on Friday.

Follow-up from the evaluation team. A receptionist says the web form may have diverted some callers out of the queue. This is a plausible explanation, but the trial did not track people across channels. The finance team wants to remove one staffed hour next week. Before the visit, decide which fact belongs in a decision meeting and which instruction a visitor can act on tomorrow. Neither version should turn the suggestion to reduce staffing into an announced change.
reading: What limitation must both versions preserve?
A shorter wait is only established for successful web bookings
The pilot measured successful web bookings only.
median wait for successful web bookings
input.transcript: Analyst: What we can say is that people who completed the web form waited less during the pilot. We still need figures on unfinished bookings. Visitor: Will I get in faster if I come tomorrow? Adviser: I cannot promise a shorter desk queue. You can still register there, or you can use the form from home. Visitor: I might need help reading it. Adviser: Call in advance and ask if a volunteer will be there. I can give you the number now. Analyst: Shall we call this a permanent improvement? Adviser: I would say it is a promising result for successful web bookings during the trial. Visitor: Then are you cutting the desk hours? Adviser: That is a proposal, not tomorrow’s timetable. Tomorrow’s desk hours are unchanged. Analyst: We can say how the pilot was measured without guessing what happened to callers. Adviser: And I can give the visitor the opening time first.

main: What can the visitor do to ask for assistance?
detail: Who had shorter waits in the data?

reading: Who is missing from the count?

lessons.readingPurpose: Bir kaynak cümlesini iki dinleyiciye ayırırken korunacak bilgilerin altını çiz.
lessons.readingUse: Analist ve ziyaretçi için birer farklı ilk cümle kur.
lessons.listeningUse: Dinleyicinin yeni kaygısına yanıt verirken sonucun sınırını geri söyle.
lessons.speaking: Kısa bir okul pilotunu önce yöntem komitesine, sonra yarın kayıt yapacak bir veliye özetle. Veli bir garanti isteyince sınırı koru ve sonraki eylemi belirt.

recovery.main: Kayıt yardımı garanti mi, aramayla mı netleşiyor?
